ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #13
====

GRADE: Grade 1
SUBJECT: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only carbon dioxide
   B. Nitrogen gas only
   C. Only water vapour
   D. Glucose and oxygen

2. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   B. Petrol fires have no fuel
   C. Water removes heat too quickly
   D. Water always increases oxygen

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Weather and Sky its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Weather and Sky its resources.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Weather and Sky its resources.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Weather and Sky its resources.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Weather and Sky its resources.

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Plants its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Plants its resources.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Plants its resources.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Plants its resources.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Plants its resources.

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Keeping home? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Keeping home.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Keeping home.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Keeping home.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Keeping home.

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Water? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Water.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Water.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Water.

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Soil its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Soil its resources.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Soil its resources.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Soil its resources.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Soil its resources.

8. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   B. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   C. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   D. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Uses of water? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Uses of water.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Uses of water.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Uses of water.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Uses of water.

10. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 100 °C
   B. 0 °C
   C. 37 °C
   D. 50 °C

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Sounds that alert us? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Sounds that alert us.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Sounds that alert us.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Sounds that alert us.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Sounds that alert us.

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Animals resources? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Animals resources.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Animals resources.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Animals resources.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Animals resources.

13. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Paper burning to ash
   B. Ice melting to water
   C. Milk souring
   D. Iron rusting

14. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Decomposers only
   B. Primary consumers only
   C. Producers
   D. Tertiary consumers

15. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Burning crop residue every week
   B. Removing all vegetation
   C. Overgrazing continuously
   D. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

16. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Energy resources? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Energy resources.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Energy resources.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Energy resources.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Energy resources.

17. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Caring for c) develop positive attitude towards things found in the home (cleani? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Caring for c) develop positive attitude towards things found in the home (cleani.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Caring for c) develop positive attitude towards things found in the home (cleani.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Caring for c) develop positive attitude towards things found in the home (cleani.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Caring for c) develop positive attitude towards things found in the home (cleani.

18. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Exploring weather? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Exploring weather.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Exploring weather.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Exploring weather.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Exploring weather.

19. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture of two liquids
   B. Any white crystal used in cooking
   C. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   D. Any substance that conducts electricity

20. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Harmful effects of? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Harmful effects of.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Harmful effects of.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Harmful effects of.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Harmful effects of.

21. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   B. Heating until a solid melts
   C. A chemical reaction forming ash
   D. Movement of water only across a membrane

22. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. joule (J)
   B. pascal (Pa)
   C. newton (N)
   D. watt (W)

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
23. In three clear sentences, explain Exploring and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

31. In three clear sentences, explain Exploring weather and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

32. In three clear sentences, explain Water and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
